description: This file contains shell script code for configuring, managing, and initializing Wi-Fi interfaces using the mac80211 driver stack within a Linux-based embedded system. It includes functions for setting up wireless interfaces, handling configurations for different modes (ap, sta, mesh, monitor), and managing capabilities related to IEEE 802.11ax, 802.11ac, and 802.11ax standards, among other wireless configuration tasks.

methods.name: drv_mac80211_init_device_config
methods.description: Initializes device-specific wireless configuration parameters for mac80211 devices, including adding device configuration options such as path, phy, MAC address, transmission settings, and capabilities.

methods.name: drv_mac80211_init_iface_config
methods.description: Sets up interface-specific configuration options such as MAC address, mode, WDS, mesh ID, and other parameters for mac80211 wireless interfaces.

methods.name: mac80211_add_capabilities
methods.description: Adds specified wireless capabilities to a capability mask based on given capability strings, filtering based on mask and capability flags.

methods.name: mac80211_add_he_capabilities
methods.description: Adds High-Efficiency (HE) wireless capabilities to the configuration based on the PHY capabilities.

methods.name: mac80211_hostapd_setup_base
methods.description: Creates the base configuration for hostapd for a given PHY, setting channels, HT/VHT/HE capabilities, and other parameters.

methods.name: mac80211_hostapd_setup_bss
methods.description: Configures an individual BSS (Basic Service Set) interface for hostapd, including MAC address, mode, and other BSS-specific options.

methods.name: mac80211_get_addr
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address assigned to a specific wireless PHY device.

methods.name: mac80211_generate_mac
methods.description: Generates a MAC address for a wireless interface using specified parameters.

methods.name: get_board_phy_name
methods.description: Looks up the physical interface name based on the board configuration JSON, with fallback to default names.

methods.name: rename_board_phy_by_path
methods.description: Renames a PHY device based on its path in the board configuration JSON file.

methods.name: rename_board_phy_by_name
methods.description: Renames a PHY device in the system to match the name specified in the board configuration JSON.

methods.name: find_phy
methods.description: Attempts to identify and set the physical interface name for a device based on various identifiers like name, path, or MAC address.

methods.name: mac80211_check_ap
methods.description: Checks for the presence of an Access Point (AP) and sets a flag.

methods.name: mac80211_set_ifname
methods.description: Sets the interface name for a wireless interface based on a prefix and index.

methods.name: mac80211_prepare_vif
methods.description: Prepares a virtual interface configuration, including mode, SSID, MAC address, and other wireless parameters.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_adhoc
methods.description: Configures an adhoc (IBSS) wireless network interface.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_mesh
methods.description: Configures a mesh network interface.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_monitor
methods.description: Configures a monitor mode wireless interface.

methods.name: mac80211_set_vif_txpower
methods.description: Sets the transmit power for a virtual interface.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the wpa_supplicant configuration JSON structure.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_add_interface
methods.description: Adds a wireless interface configuration to wpa_supplicant.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_set_config
methods.description: Sends the wpa_supplicant configuration JSON to the system and potentially starts the process.

methods.name: hostapd_set_config
methods.description: Configures hostapd for a specific PHY with the assembled configuration.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_start
methods.description: Starts the wpa_supplicant process for a PHY.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_supplicant
methods.description: Sets up wpa_supplicant for a wireless interface.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_vif
methods.description: Prepares and configures a virtual interface, including modes, capabilities, and starting necessary processes.

methods.name: get_freq
methods.description: Retrieves the frequency for a given PHY, channel, and band.

methods.name: chan_is_dfs
methods.description: Checks whether a given channel on a PHY requires DFS (radar detection).

methods.name: mac80211_set_noscan
methods.description: Enables no-scan mode for a wireless interface.

methods.name: mac80211_teardown
methods.description: Placeholder function to perform cleanup of wireless setup.

methods.name: mac80211_reset_config
methods.description: Resets hostapd and wpa_supplicant configurations for a given PHY.

methods.name: mac80211_set_suffix
methods.description: Sets suffix identifiers for PHY and VIF interface naming.

methods.name: drv_mac80211_setup
methods.description: Main setup function for initializing mac80211 device configuration, interfaces, and virtual interfaces.

methods.name: drv_mac80211_cleanup
methods.description: Cleanup placeholder function.
